Himachal

Himachal is a comic-based visual storytelling project following Bittu, a young boy visiting his grandparents' Himalayan village. Through stories and diagrams, he discovers traditional tools, sustainable practices, and self-sufficient systems. The project celebrates cultural heritage and encourages children to document and preserve their own local knowledge.
